It is essential to continue using this medication for the entire prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve after a few days. Common side effects include swelling, redness, or irritation at the injection site, as well as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or headache. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before using caspofungin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other echinocandin antifungal drugs (such as anidulafungin or micafungin), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It is unknown if this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: Laboratory and medical tests (such as liver and kidney function tests or potassium blood levels) should be performed while you are using this medication. Missed Dose: It is crucial to receive each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. Storage: Refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for proper storage details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This summary does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
